requirements.title: The /graph page shall move keyboard focus to the header search input when the visitor presses Ctrl+K or the forward-slash key

vision.paraphrase: Keyboard support with Ctrl+K affordance enables technical visitors to jump to search by reflex.
Search lives in the header with a Ctrl+K affordance enabling rapid query entry for keyboard-driven visitors.

conops.paraphrase: When a visitor presses Ctrl+K or /, the header search input receives keyboard focus, enabling rapid query entry.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall clear the search query and remove focus from the search input when the visitor presses Esc while the search input is focused

vision.paraphrase: Esc closes popovers and clears the node selection as part of a keyboard de-escalation chain.

conops.paraphrase: When the visitor presses Esc while the search input is focused, the query clears and focus leaves the input.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall clear the current node selection when the visitor presses Esc while a node is selected, returning the side panel to the start-anywhere card

vision.paraphrase: Esc clears node selection as part of the keyboard de-escalation chain, returning the visitor to the onboarding state.

conops.paraphrase: When a visitor presses Esc with a node selected, the selection clears and the side panel returns to the start-anywhere card.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall close the Options popover when the visitor presses Esc, leaving the underlying page immediately clickable

vision.paraphrase: Keyboard support closes popovers on Esc, fixing issue #4 finding A4 where the backdrop swallowed the next click.

conops.paraphrase: When a visitor presses Esc with the Options popover open, the popover closes immediately and the next click registers on the board.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall exit the guided tour when the visitor presses Esc during a tour step

conops.paraphrase: During a guided tour, Esc exits the tour, leaving the current step's node selected.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall de-escalate exactly one UI state per Esc press, in the order tour, then Options popover, then search, then node selection

conops.paraphrase: The Esc de-escalation chain peels one layer per press in order: tour, Options popover, search query, then node selection.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall render the graph board at a usable width occupying the majority of the viewport at a 390px viewport width

vision.paraphrase: Responsive layout at 390px ensures the page works for mobile visitors, fixing issue #4 finding A5 where the board was crushed to a sliver.
390px viewport width is the design floor for /graph usability on mobile devices.

conops.paraphrase: When a visitor opens /graph on a 390px-wide mobile device, the board occupies at least 80% of the viewport width.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall present the side panel as a bottom sheet overlay, rather than a side column, when a node is selected at a 390px viewport width

vision.paraphrase: Responsive layout transforms the side panel into a bottom sheet on mobile, keeping the board usable on small screens.

conops.paraphrase: When a node is selected at 390px width, the side panel appears as a bottom sheet overlay rather than a fixed sidebar.

requirements.title: The bottom sheet shall select the target node when a visitor taps a connected-page chip within it at a 390px viewport width

conops.paraphrase: On mobile, tapping a connected-page chip in the bottom sheet selects that node and updates the sheet's content.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall leave the board interactive after the visitor dismisses the bottom sheet at a 390px viewport width

conops.paraphrase: After dismissing the bottom sheet on mobile, the board remains fully interactive and tappable.

requirements.title: The /graph page shall render the header, search input, and hero row legibly and within the viewport at a 390px viewport width

conops.paraphrase: On mobile at 390px width, the header, search input, and hero row all render legibly without requiring horizontal scrolling.
